cohort: 190 women with multiple pregnancies (106 spontaneous conceptions and 84 ART conceptions) who gave birth at Women Hospital between 2004 and 2009
finding: Multiple pregnancies conceived by ART were associated with higher rates of preterm labor, PROM, NICU admission, longer hospitalization, stillbirth, and low gestational age compared to spontaneous conceptions, while spontaneous conceptions had higher rates of PIH and neonatal jaundice.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery significantly differed between multiple pregnancies conceived by ART and those conceived spontaneously.
